caroline: Heads-up — I rolled tiny-slate-embed-v2 q4fs to staging for a quick smoke and noticed a large recall@1 drop on short queries (<=8 tokens). anyone else seeing this?

sara: Which evaluation set did you run?

caroline: seatbelt-shortset (2k short queries) + wiki-sample 10k. Quick numbers below (short queries only):
```
baseline fp16  | r@1 0.84 | r@5 0.94 | r@10 0.97
q4fs per-tensor  | r@1 0.58 | r@5 0.85 | r@10 0.92
```

vikas: Oof. Can you paste the index/build params? per-channel vs per-tensor? hnsw efConstruction/efSearch? similarity metric?

caroline: Per-tensor q4 (we followed the generic tiny-quant profile). HNSW: M=32, efConstruction=128, efSearch=64. Similarity=cosine. No extra normalization after dequant.

liz: Quick thought: short queries are sensitive to tokenization edge-cases and L2 scaling. Try renormalizing vectors after dequant (force unit norm) and re-eval. Also try dot-product vs cosine to check scale effects.

caroline: Good call. Kicked off two jobs: (1) renormalize post-dequant + cosine, (2) per-channel q8 quick run on 10k to compare. ETA ~45m. Also noticed UMAP cluster purity dropped for small snippets — looked like many very-short punct-like queries landing near origin.

deploy-bot: Staging deploy complete: tiny-slate-embed-v2 q4fs -> nodes (3/3) :rocket:

sara: If punct-only tokens map to empty vectors after tokenizer, they can collapse to near-zero after quant. Can you run a tokenization sanity check for the short set? simple python snippet: 
```python
for q in short_queries[:20]:
    toks = tokenizer(q)
    vec = model.embed(q)
    print(q, toks, np.linalg.norm(vec))
```

caroline: Ran token check on the top 100 failing queries. Found ~12 queries tokenizing to only special/punct tokens or single unknown tokens -> embeddings norm < 1e-3. Those go to the origin and break nearest-neighbor. Patch: filter out queries with norm < 1e-2 before eval; also will normalize remaining vectors.

caroline: After filtering + renorm (and per-channel q8 run finishing) quick metrics:
```
q4fs per-tensor (orig): r@1 0.58 | r@5 0.85
q4fs + filter+renorm: r@1 0.79 | r@5 0.92
q8 per-channel: r@1 0.82 | r@5 0.93
baseline fp16: r@1 0.84 | r@5 0.94
```

sara: Nice recovery. So two issues: tokenizer edge-cases and per-tensor quant losing scale fidelity for short signals. Agree we should prefer per-channel for tiny-slate-embed-v2 as default quant profile.

vikas: Also add a preprocess step to drop or special-case punctuation-only queries (or return a deterministic small vector) so they don't skew metrics. Add unit test for token->norm threshold.

liz: Can you also add a quick script to compare cosine vs dot on the same vectors? If renorm fixes it, cosine/dot should converge.

caroline: Yup. I'll open a PR with: (a) onboarding note documenting the q-profile choice; (b) eval artifacts (norm histogram, UMAP before/after); (c) unit test for token-norm threshold; (d) change default quant profile to per-channel for tiny-slate-embed-v2. Filing ticket INF-4123 and PR shortly. Link to draft artifacts: https://redwood-internal.s3/embeds/tiny-slate/q4-triage-1746501234

vikas: Thanks. After PR, let's run a full recall sweep (short+long+multilingual) and then promote to dedicated canary.

caroline: Will do. Marking this triaged for now. :white_check_mark:
